# GitHub repository About

## Description

Turn your docs into answers for your community. Answer questions in Discord, Slack, GitHub, and website chat with source-backed replies your team can review before sending. Self-host with your preferred model, use the hosted app, or connect your own agents through MCP and the API.

## Website

https://answerloops.com

## Topics

Apply this list under repository **Settings → General → Topics** — it isn't synced automatically.

```text
agent-skills ai-agent chatbot community-support customer-support discord-bot discourse helpdesk knowledge-base mcp mcp-server model-context-protocol open-source rag self-hosted slack-bot support-automation telegram-bot typescript workflow-automation
```

Dropped `ai-support` and `ticket-deflection` — neither is an established GitHub topic with real traffic (`ticket-deflection` has no topic page at all). Added `helpdesk` and `open-source`, both real, high-traffic topics this repo qualifies for that weren't previously claimed. Verified `agent-skills` and `workflow-automation` are real, active topic pages (github.com/topics/agent-skills, github.com/topics/workflow-automation) worth keeping.
